# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge is not a suggestion—it's a battle cry. Notice the order: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Strength is the last command, not the first. Too many of us chase strength without watchfulness, and we end up strong in the wrong places. We build our bodies but neglect our souls. We grind at work but drift from our families. We flex in the gym but fold under pressure.

Real strength starts with vigilance. The enemy doesn't announce his attack—he whispers compromise, laziness, and isolation. Standing firm means planting your feet on truth before the storm hits, not scrambling for footing once it's here. Acting like men means taking responsibility when it's easier to pass the blame.

Today, you'll face a hundred small choices. Each one is a rep. Choose faithfulness in the unseen moments, and God will build a strength in you that doesn't quit when life gets heavy.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with every rep, thank God for the strength He's already given you. Then text one brother and ask how you can pray for him today.
